messages:
lana-partners: hey folks — partners asked for a compact reference module set (aws + gcp) that installs Redwood Private components + minimal networking + example TF outputs. Need a split of work: module author, CI smoke, packaging notes, and a short partner README. timeline: partner preview demo in 9 business days. anyone take module author?

todd-iac: I can bootstrap the terraform modules. will create modules/core, modules/compute, modules/network and examples/marketplace-quickstart. plan: keep defaults conservative (no public IPs) but include a public-quickstart example.

nina-qa: i'll own smoke tests and CI gating. requirements: terraform apply -> health endpoint -> run a generate with test key and assert status 200 and output length < 40. will write a small harness in bash/python.

sam-cloud: packaging/marketplace checklist from my side: need AMI build + container images (multi-arch), metadata.json for marketplace, tested instance matrix (g4dn, a100, graviton options). also will add driver install snippets for nvidia.

lana-partners: good. keep branding/legal small: we can add partner logo after legal ok. please include a LICENSE (MIT-ish) and a CLA note for contributions.

todd-iac: rough smoke pseudo:

#!/bin/bash
# quick-smoke.sh
ENDPOINT="$ENDPOINT"
API_KEY="$API_KEY"
res=$(curl -s -X POST "$ENDPOINT/v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood-small","input":"ping"}')
if echo "$res" | jq -e '.error' >/dev/null; then echo "error in response"; exit 1; fi
len=$(echo "$res" | jq '.output[0].tokens | length')
if [ "$len" -gt 40 ]; then echo "too many tokens"; exit 2; fi
echo "smoke ok"

this will be run from CI against staging.

nina-qa: CI notes: we need a mock/staging API key and a small staging cluster so smoke is fast. will gate merges on smoke only. also will add trivy scan for images.

sam-cloud: multi-arch: i will publish amd64 + arm64 images and add a manifest. partners may prefer arm for cost. i will include recommended instance sizing & expected p95 latencies for small/medium/large configs in the README.

todd-iac: network options: 1) default private with NAT egress + internal LB 2) public quickstart with ALB. i'll supply both TF examples and a short diagram. also will include KMS instructions for storing secrets (do not put keys in tfvars).

lana-partners: blockers? legal for logos, security signoff for publishing AMIs, any partner-specific compliance asks?

sam-cloud: security: need to confirm image hardening checklist and include CVE gating. i'll coordinate with security team.

ci-bot: pipeline partners-refkit-samples started -> jobs: fmt ✅, lint ✅, unit-tests ✅, image-scan ⏳, smoke-test ⏳. details: https://ci.example.com/pipeline/partners-refkit/2890012345 :rocket:

lana-partners: schedule: sync in 3 days to validate artifacts. owners: todd (modules), nina (ci/smoke/tests), sam (packaging/marketplace), lana (partner coordination). thanks — will ping partner with draft timeline and ask for access to partner staging account if needed.
